requirement_evidence.evidence: Extract rejects invalid UTF-8 text. validKey rejects empty, invalid UTF-8 and prohibited runes. Matching preserves literal bytes; keys are copied into a local collection without modifying the caller's slice.

mentionStart decodes the preceding rune. identifierRune checks Unicode letters, numbers and marks plus underscore and hyphen. Extract chooses the longest literal prefix with an eligible following rune, then advances past it.
A local registered map deduplicates keys. A separate seen map suppresses duplicate results while appending mentions in source scan order.
The per-line codeLength tracks complete backtick runs. Only an equal-length run closes a span; unmatched spans hide the remaining line. codeLength resets for each line.

fenceStart accepts zero through three ASCII spaces and counts marker runs. Extract retains fence character and length between lines; closing requires the same marker, sufficient length and only trailing spaces or tabs. CR is removed only before LF.

Quoted lines are skipped before fence handling. mentionStart rejects odd backslash runs before checking the preceding rune. Left boundaries exclude email forms; ordinary quotation marks receive no special treatment.
Route maps Human Pending, Busy and Finished to start, soon and new. It calls Extract and creates exactly one delivery per returned key in the same order.
Route permits Agent only in Busy with soon. Unknown authors and states return no deliveries. Extract remains independent, and all mutable parsing and routing state is local to each call.
